audit_name: EXP-07 Canonical Taxonomy Forensics and Reconciliation Audit

c18_narrative_corruptions.erroneous_taxonomy_text: MCC, IWs, BS, LWA, POW, OF, WS, AS, Eddy, HM, Thermal
c18_narrative_corruptions.root_cause: Transcription and narrative drift in markdown report synthesis. The underlying machine-readable JSON audits (ops02_c18_class_weights_audit_v1.json, ops02_c18_sampler_protocol_audit_v1.json) correctly contained the canonical class names (0_BG through 11_HM, AF, RF), but the markdown report text incorrectly mapped class 8 to 'AS' and class 11 to 'Thermal'.
c18_narrative_corruptions.corrective_action: Formal repudiation of erroneous taxonomy tokens. Canonical taxonomy reaffirmed across all C19 and future specifications. Historical report preserved unedited under immutability rules.

semantic_clarifications.HM: HM stands for Artificial / Anthropogenic Objects (Human-Made objects, including maritime vessels, offshore platforms, infrastructure). It is NOT vessel-only.
semantic_clarifications.OF: OF stands strictly for Ocean Front (thermal/salinity/dynamic oceanographic front). It is NOT oil film or oil spill.
semantic_clarifications.RF: RF stands for Rain Cell / Rain Footprint.
semantic_clarifications.POW: POW stands for Pure Ocean Wave.
